name: unsafe fn from_raw_socket (sock : RawSocket) -> Self
rule: The sock passed to from_raw_socket must be an owned socket; in particular, it must be open.
api: trait FromRawSocket  : { unsafe fn from_raw_socket (sock : std::os::windows::io::raw::RawSocket) -> Self }
expression: The requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL: it provides no observation for socket ownership or whether a socket is open.
